slides.title: IP assignment
slides.body: Is it signed? Does it cover subcontractors? Has a lawyer reviewed it? Ask for the open-source licenses at handover too.

slides.title: Repository
slides.body: Whose organization is it in? If it's the contractor's, transfer it. Commit history, issues and pull requests move with it.

slides.title: Cloud and hosting
slides.body: Whose card pays the bill? Is the owner login a company email more than one person can reach, with two-factor on?

slides.title: Domain
slides.body: Who's the registrant, and who holds the registrar login? Check with ICANN's lookup tool. Your email depends on it.

slides.title: Credentials
slides.body: Payment, email, SMS, Apple and Google developer accounts: in your name? Keys in a password manager you control?

slides.title: Documentation
slides.body: Run it on a new machine, deploy a change, find each secret. Could a new hire set it up without the contractor?
